info.title: GeoLocations API

post.description:
Create geo location targeting definitions. Supports smart locations, which target users based on their percentile rank within a Smart Location Index, and radius locations, which target users within a specified distance of an address or coordinate. Note: radius locations are currently in beta. Create is the only operation for geo locations: there is no retrieve, update or delete. Create is not idempotent, so each successful request returns a new geoLocationId. A geo location is only visible to the advertiser account that created it. Store the success items from the create response, and use geoLocationId as the locationId of a LOCATION target. To change a radius location, create a new geo location and a new LOCATION target, then remove the old target. For a radius location, provide either pointOfInterestAddress or coordinates, not both. The radius must be between 2 and 100 miles in the US, and between 2 and 100 kilometers in other supported countries.

**Requires one of these permissions**:
["advertiser_campaign_edit", "campaign_edit", "dsp_campaign_edit", 
"MasterAccount_Manager"]
